name: crowdin
description: Agent Skills for Crowdin, an AI-powered localization platform for teams and businesses

interface.longDescription:
Crowdin brings localization into your coding agent. Ask it to set up translation for a project, keep source files and translations in sync through the Crowdin CLI and GitHub Action, write translator context for ambiguous strings, build a glossary from your own vocabulary, or query strings, translations and translation memory with CroQL and GraphQL. It follows the same practices the Crowdin team uses: it asks before changing anything in a project, keeps tokens out of files and chat, and never invents translations.

Connect your Crowdin account and the agent works with live project data: files, source strings and translations, translation progress by language, comments, glossaries, translation memories, tasks and reports. The skills run in your repository from Codex; the Crowdin tools work wherever the plugin is installed, including ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Set up Crowdin localization for this project
Write a crowdin.yml and upload our source files
Add translator context to our Crowdin strings
